'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''

**[[Crimea attacks (2022–present)|Crimea attacks]]
***[[Russia]]'s [[Ministry of Defence (Russia)|defence ministry]] says that it destroyed a [[Ukraine|Ukrainian]] boat in the [[Black Sea]]. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/liveblog/2023/9/14/russia-ukraine-war-live-six-year-old-killed-in-russian-shelling-kyiv-says (Al Jazeera)]

'''Business and economy'''
*[[Economy of Argentina]]
**The [[National Institute of Statistics and Census of Argentina|National Institute of Statistics and Census]] announces that [[consumer]] prices in [[Argentina]] increased 12.4% in August, the highest increase since February 1991, while the annual [[inflation]] rate increased to 124.4%. [https://apnews.com/article/argentina-inflation-massa-milei-bullrich-b7bc9e0b33c05833d0ccb6b1614b086c (AP)]
*[[Economy of the European Union]]
**The [[European Central Bank]] raises [[interest rate]]s for the 10th time to mitigate high inflation amid concerns that higher borrowing costs could push the economy into a [[recession]]. [https://apnews.com/article/european-central-bank-interest-rates-inflation-recession-1b7ad9f3f6e9522de05d7b3c1f93e437 (AP)]
*[[Russian invasion of Ukraine]]
**[[Ukraine]]'s [[Minister of Foreign Affairs (Ukraine)|foreign ministry]] says that any [[European Union]] plans to extend [[import restriction]]s on Ukrainian food would be "illegal" and would harm common economic interests. [https://www.reuters.com/article/ukraine-crisis-grains-restrictions-idAFS8N3AK05K (Reuters)]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*Two people are killed and 25 more are injured in a [[traffic collision|collision]] between a bus and a truck on a highway in [[Rome]], [[Italy]]. [https://www.ilmessaggero.it/italia/incidente_pullman_migranti_morti_autisti_feriti_a1_roma_viabilita_traffico_lampedusa_che_cosa_sappiamo-7633331.html (Il Messaggero)]
*An explosion at the [[Union Pacific Railroad]] [[Bailey Yard]] in [[North Platte]], [[Nebraska]], [[United States]], the world’s largest [[railyard]], causes evacuations in the area due to toxic smoke. [https://apnews.com/article/union-pacific-railroad-railyard-fire-hazardous-materials-9527651cde6c629f18bb947f95ab9f42 (AP)]

'''International relations'''
*[[Recognition of the Islamic Emirate of Afghanistan]], [[Afghanistan–China relations]]
**[[China]] names Zhao Seng as [[ambassador]] to [[Afghanistan]], the first country to deliver an ambassador to Afghanistan since the [[2021 Taliban offensive]]. However, China continues to not recognise the Taliban government. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-asia-china-66805404 (BBC News)]

'''Law and crime'''
*[[8 January Brasília attacks|2023 Brazilian Congress attack]]
**The [[Supreme Federal Court|Brazilian Supreme Court]] announces the first [[conviction]] of a participant in the January 8 [[riot]]s at the [[Praça dos Três Poderes]] in [[Brasília]]. The member, identified as Aécio Lúcio Costa Pereira, is given a 17-year prison [[sentence (law)|sentence]]. [https://www.ft.com/content/ba019e16-389b-4973-bd9f-c8d83b61c432 (''Financial Times'')]
*[[International Criminal Court investigation in Ukraine]]
**The [[International Criminal Court]] opens a field office in [[Kyiv]], [[Ukraine]], as part of its [[War crimes in the Russian invasion of Ukraine|war crimes]] investigations, becoming the largest ICC office outside of its headquarters in [[The Hague]], [[Netherlands]]. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/liveblog/2023/9/14/russia-ukraine-war-live-six-year-old-killed-in-russian-shelling-kyiv-says (Al Jazeera)]
*[[Mexican drug war]]
**[[Emma Coronel Aispuro|Emma Coronel]], the wife of Mexican [[drug kingpin]] [[Joaquín "El Chapo" Guzmán]], is released from U.S. federal custody after completing a three-year sentence for her involvement in [[drug trafficking]]. [https://apnews.com/article/el-chapo-wife-released-prison-b4ba4509ea9a762cfc12de39ac5ea59e (AP)]
*[[Weiss special counsel investigation]]
**[[Hunter Biden]], son of [[President of the United States|U.S. President]] [[Joe Biden]], is indicted on gun charges as part of an investigation by [[United States Attorney|attorney]] [[David C. Weiss]]. [https://www.nbcnews.com/politics/politics-news/hunter-biden-indicted-federal-gun-charges-rcna39623 (NBC News)]
*[[Argentina]]'s [[Argentine Federal Police|Federal Police]] shuts down a [[publisher]] that sold books supporting [[Nazi]] [[ideology]], seizing hundreds of texts and arresting one person as part of what authorities characterized as a historic seizure of [[propaganda]]. [https://apnews.com/article/argentina-nazi-publisher-books-propaganda-07ff08333c3f0ea9c4920bb5f158b4a7 (AP)]
